correctness.rationale: The original constrained factor graph is strongly connected. The explicitly defined augmentation duplicates every allowed nonzero k-factor with zero endpoints, exactly F_k-1 edges, and balances all vertices. The one-based rightmost-one potential h satisfies h(pre)-h(suf)<=1 on every edge, with equality on every duplicated edge; the divergence invariant therefore bounds all other balanced augmentations below by F_k-1 extra edges. Equality is supported on a subgraph with h strictly decreasing and at most one tight outgoing edge per vertex; the homogeneous conservation system has trivial kernel, proving uniqueness of the extra-multiplicity vector. Standard-library verifier rebuilds every graph k=2..14, checks balances, constructs and literally scans Euler cycles, and exhaustively checks short cases. Finite experiments were not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: Primary sources supply general algorithms for arbitrary k-substring coverage and distinct local no-repetition constraints, but their inspected claims do not entail without new special-family analysis the explicit F_{k+2}+F_k-1 length and unique 0u0-duplication profile. Searches also tested aliases golden-mean shift, forbidden 11, directed postman, cyclic superstring and Fibonacci universal cycles; no equivalent all-parameter statement was identified. Classical hidden specializations remain possible. The generic Eulerian-walk approach is acknowledged as prior.
residual_risks: A closed Fibonacci shortest-postman formula or the equality-case traversal profile may occur under older golden-mean symbolic dynamics or universal-cycle terminology not indexed by the inspected searches.

The known general directed Chinese-postman framework already solves each finite graph algorithmically; the claimed distinct contribution is the formula and exact rigidity, not decidability or an algorithm for arbitrary factor languages.

value.rationale: A circular word that tests every admissible local pattern is a natural constrained universal-cycle / exhaustive word-testing object. The answer is a complete infinite exact length law, constructive shortest tour and uniqueness of all length-k factor multiplicities for a non-Eulerian family. It identifies the unavoidable repeated patterns in every optimum. This is substantially more information than the trivial number F_{k+2} of admissible k-words or an isolated finite enumerative increment.
